mapper.insert: insert into u_s_followup(sitecode, targettype, targetcode, action, content, createuser, createtime) values(#{siteCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetCode}, #{action}, #{content}, #{createUser}, sysdate())
mapper.sql: from u_s_inquiry i left join ( select targetcode, max(createtime) as lasttime from u_s_followup where targettype = 'inquiry' group by targetcode ) f on f.targetcode = i.inquirycode where i.status not in ('已成交', '无效')
mapper.select:
select i.id as id, i.inquirycode as inquiryCode, i.name as name, i.company as company, i.email as email, i.producttitle as productTitle, i.status as status, i.owner as owner, i.nextfollow as nextFollow, i.createtime as createTime, as lastTouch, datediff(curdate(), date()) as idleDays
and ( (i.nextfollow is not null and i.nextfollow < curdate()) or (i.nextfollow is null and datediff(curdate(), date()) >= #{staleDays}) )
and i.nextfollow = curdate()
and (i.owner is null or i.owner = '')
and i.owner = #{owner}
order by (i.nextfollow is null), i.nextfollow, datediff(curdate(), date()) desc, i.id desc limit 300

select count(*) as openCount, sum(case when (i.nextfollow is not null and i.nextfollow < curdate()) or (i.nextfollow is null and datediff(curdate(), date()) >= #{staleDays}) then 1 else 0 end) as overdueCount, sum(case when i.nextfollow = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayCount, sum(case when i.owner is null or i.owner = '' then 1 else 0 end) as unownedCount
